title: 1958 AHSME Problem 24
statement: A man travels \(m\) feet due north at \(2\) minutes per mile. He returns due south to his starting point at \(2\) miles per minute. The average rate in miles per hour for the entire trip is:

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: impossible to determine without knowing the value of \(m\)

solutions.text:
The northbound rate is \(30\) mph, and the southbound rate is \(120\) mph. For equal distances, the round-trip average is \[ \frac{2(30)(120)}{30+120}=48\text{ mph}. \] The distance \(m\) cancels.

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: Convert both stated rates to miles per hour
For equal distances, divide twice the one-way distance by the sum of the two travel times
